posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked: So when I was counting Wraith cards, I was missing one card (specifically, Utility Belt, the same card awmiller claimed to be missing). Today while setting up a game, I counted my Omnitron deck and found it was missing a card (all other decks were accounted for). Specifically, it apeared I was missing Terraforming. So, it appeared I was missing the last card of the hero cards and the last card of the villian cards, as well as missing the same exact cards awmiller was missing. I also found said missing cards. Turns out the cards were sticking to each other. I’m guessing maybe the coating isnt drying all the way before they cut and stacked them at the printer. Though, this would only likely affect people with a recently opened copy of the game. Playing a game or two would generate enough stress on the cards to break any adhesion between the cards.

posts.name: WriterRyan
posts.cooked: The problem is that, based on just how stuck together they are, there’s a chance it will damage the cards when they’re separated.

posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked: The level of stickiness that I noticed was very small, enough to prevent shearing apart, but not enough to cause any damage to the cards. If you were to take a full deck and slightly bend the cards back and forth, that would likely be enough to get the cards apart.

posts.name: awmiller
posts.cooked: This is EXACTLY what happened to me. I found both cards in exactly the same way. It has to be some sort of machine/manufacturing thing.

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: Regarding games with missing cards, we had a really awful experience with the QC of the printer for Sentinels of the Multiverse, which is one of several reasons why we’ve switched printers for Rook City (also because we could get higher quality cardstock, etc for the cards and boxes). If anyone is missing any cards from the core game, or has damaged cards, send me an email at paul@sentinelsofthemultiverse.com with a photo of the damaged card and I’ll send you a replacement free of charge.
